Add a warm, artistic touch to your holiday creations with this **Hand-Drawn Christmas Patterns Digital Seamless Collection**. Inspired by the charm of handmade Christmas artwork, these designs feature festive trees, ornaments, snowflakes, stars, holly leaves, evergreen branches, berries, gifts, bows, ribbons, and other delightful seasonal details.
